I’m sorry—I don’t have a built‑in way to talk directly to VirusTotal’s “add comment” endpoint right now.  
Here’s a quick example you can run yourself (replace **YOUR_API_KEY** with your real key):

```bash
curl -X POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments \
     -H "x-apikey: YOUR_API_KEY" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     --data '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Needs review #unsure"}}'
```

Or, in Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "YOUR_API_KEY",
    "Accept-Encoding": "gzip, deflate",
}
payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": { "text": "Needs review #unsure" }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.status_code, response.json())
```

That should add the comment to the IP address record. Let me know if you hit any snags!
